item.description: Killington Resort will open for the season tomorrow the seventeenth. First chair will be at ten a.m. or possibly earlier. This is the resort's third winter under independent ownership.

Vermont Fish and Wildlife is issuing antlerless deer permits for the first time in nearly forty years. Hunters must win these permits in a state lottery, each valid for one deer in one wildlife management unit. The permits also apply during muzzleloader season from November thirtieth through December thirteenth for hunters who don't succeed in rifle season.

Vermont Digger reports that Vermont is spending over five million dollars on McKinsey for healthcare consulting. McKinsey has been criticized for its role in the opioid crisis and promoting OxyContin. The state's health funding focuses on regionalization, telehealth, and artificial intelligence.

A new biography explores the life of Adirondack 'Woodswoman' Anne LaBastille. She was a conservationist, author, and Adirondack Park commissioner. The book highlights her global work and challenges as a pioneering woman.
